thumburu nAradhulu suguNa kIrthanambulu nAlApamu sEyagA
ambarIsha mukhyulu nAmamu sEyaga jAjulapai challaga
bimbAdharulagu suravara yali vENulu nATyamu lADagA
ambuja bhava pAkAru lirugadaLa nanvaya birudhAvalini pogadagA
ambara vAsa sathulu kara kankaNambulu ghallani visaraga
mani hArambulu gadalaga nUchE phani thalpambuna nElakonna harini ganuga

lyrics: charaNam 2 -
marakata maNi sannibha dEhambuna merugu kanaka chElamu shObhilla charaNa
yuga nakhAvali kAntulu canduru pillalanu gEra vara nUpuramu vEluga karayugamuna
vajrapu bhUSaNamulu meraya uramuna muktAhAramulu mariyu nucitamaina makara
kuNDalambulu ciru navvulu gala vadanambuna munguru laddampu kapOlamu muddu
guriyu divya phAlambuna thilakamu merayu bhuvi lAvaNya nidhini kana
charaNam 3 -
thAmasa guNa rahita munulaku pogada - tharamu gAkane bhramasi nilvaga
shrImat kanakapu thoTlapaini cheluvonda koluvuNDaga
kAmitha phala dhAyakiyau sIta kAnthuni gani uppondaga
rAmabhrahma thanayudau thyAgarAju thA pADuchu nUchaga
rAmuni jagaduddhAruni suraripu bhImuni triguNAthItuni
pUrNa kAmuni chinmaya rUpuni sadguNa dhAmuni kanulAra madhini kanugona
